notes: "Delivery has two parts. The project folder is the real deliverable: it is fully editable and carries the Story, the Presentations and the named versions. Hand it to a co-author and they continue from where you stopped. For people who only need to view the talk, HUANDENG exports PDF and PPTX, either of Main Slides or of a particular Presentation, including any pinned versions. In PPTX, supported objects stay native and editable in PowerPoint; anything that cannot be represented natively is exported as an image, and the export report says which objects that happened to. Click-by-click animation is a live-presentation feature and is not carried into these static files. This deck's PDF and PPTX were exported the same way."

designIntent.purpose: Explain delivery as the editable project plus static PDF/PPTX, with the animation limitation.
